blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Software comes in several kinds. Enterprise software is big and complex. It runs inside a whole company — an ERP, a CRM, or an HR system.

SaaS means Software as a Service. It is software you rent, not software you buy. You usually use it through a web browser. Cloud software runs on servers somewhere else, not on your own computer.

Modern companies usually mix all three. The ERP might be on the cloud. The sales tools might be SaaS. A few special tools might still run on local machines. The job of IT is to keep them all working together quietly.

items.q: What kind of software is big and complex and runs inside a whole company?
items.why: "Enterprise software is big and complex. It runs inside a whole company."

items.q: What does SaaS mean?
options: Software as a Service — software you rent
items.why: "SaaS means Software as a Service. It is software you rent, not software you buy."

items.q: Where does cloud software run?
items.why: "Cloud software runs on servers somewhere else, not on your own computer."

items.q: The text suggests that a modern company usually uses…
options: more than one kind of software together
items.why: Inferência: "Modern companies usually mix all three" — elas usam vários tipos juntos.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: A company should use only one kind of software and nothing else.
Some tools can run on the cloud.
IT keeps different software working together.
SaaS is used through a web browser.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que empresas misturam os três tipos, então usar só um contraria a ideia central.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry mostrando os tipos de software para um novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team! Let me show you the software we use every day. Don't worry, it is simple.

First, we have the big one: the ERP. That is enterprise software. It is large and it runs the whole company — finance, orders, everything. It lives on the cloud, so it runs on a server, not on your laptop.

Next, the sales team uses a CRM. That one is SaaS. We do not buy it; we rent it every month. You open it in your web browser, and you are ready to go.

We also have a few small tools that still run on local machines here in the office. They are old, but they work well, so we keep them.

My job in IT is to keep all of them working together quietly. When you need help, just call me. And please, remember to install the updates — they keep everything safe. Any questions? Great, let's start.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What kind of software is the ERP, according to Harry?
items.why: "the ERP. That is enterprise software."

items.q: How does the sales team pay for the CRM?
items.why: "That one is SaaS. We do not buy it; we rent it every month."

items.q: Where does the ERP run?
options: On the cloud, on a server
items.why: "It lives on the cloud, so it runs on a server, not on your laptop."

items.q: Why does the team keep the old tools on local machines?
items.why: Inferência: "They are old, but they work well, so we keep them."

items.q: What does Harry want the new joiner to do to stay safe?
items.why: Inferência: "remember to install the updates — they keep everything safe."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The whole company runs on one big ERP." An ERP is…
options: a large system that manages finance, HR and operations
items.why: ERP = sistema grande que junta finanças, RH e operações em uma só plataforma.

items.q: "The sales team uses a CRM to help with clients." A CRM helps teams…
items.why: CRM = software para gerir o relacionamento com os clientes.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "You open SaaS tools in your ___."
items.why: Web browser = navegador; é onde você abre as ferramentas SaaS.

items.q: "Cloud software runs on a server, not on your laptop." A server is…
options: a computer that stores and runs software for others
items.why: Server = servidor; computador que guarda e roda o software para os outros.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We do not buy this tool; we ___ it every month."
items.why: To rent = alugar; você paga todo mês em vez de comprar.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem quando o time fala de software. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager still has to sign off on the new tool." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We will roll out the new CRM next month." To roll out means to…
options: start using it, step by step
items.why: Roll out = implementar, colocar em uso aos poucos.

items.q: "Please remember to back up your files." To back up means to…
items.why: Back up = fazer uma cópia de segurança.

items.q: "The old system broke, so IT had to set up a new one." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = configurar e deixar pronto para usar.

items.q: "If the app stops, just log in again." To log in means to…
options: enter with your name and password
items.why: Log in = entrar no sistema com usuário e senha.
